library.name: Smalot PdfParser
library.description: Pure-PHP PDF text extraction, vendored with the bookingextension_agent subplugin. Used as the dependency-free fallback for the agent's PDF attachment text extraction when the poppler-utils pdftotext binary is not available.

library.name: FullCalendar
library.description: Calendar of the compact slot booking view ([bookingoptionview ... calendar="compact"]). Global build with all standard plugins, its stylesheet and all locales, unchanged from the npm package.
